self-check failed: acceptance criteria not met or not reported: "Run `cargo test --locked`. It passes with every test running, and the run is under 7 minutes on the job's machine. A failing test still fails the run."; redacted report: {"summary":"The run-time sum is now about 389 s, down from 649 s, but the 7-minute goal is probably still missed. Adding the brain's 67 s compile gives about 456 s against 420 s; I did not time the whole command, because Bash has no `time`. Two behavior-preserving production changes did most of it.

**Cause.** Gitleaks start-up dominates the slow binaries. One landed fake job launches gitleaks 14 times, at 490–610 ms each (about 7.4 s of the test's 8.8 s). Each git call takes 1–8 ms. Lifecycle made 932 launches (583 text scans, 349 range scans). Most text scans repeat across tests.

**Changes.**
- `crates/athena-gate/src/secrets.rs`: `scan_text` and `scan_log` remember `Ok` results for the rest of the process.
  - The key is the generated config text, the binary path, and the text or the git dir with the range resolved to commit ids.
  - Ranges with options, `...`, open ends or unresolved names are never remembered. `Err` is never remembered. At most 4,096 entries are kept, and texts over 64 KiB are not kept.
  - A second caller of an input already being scanned waits for that scan.
  - Five new tests cover equality with an uncached scan, a repeat hit, a moved `HEAD`, a later token, text scans, and a different allow-list.
- `crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs`: `run_check` now sleeps 5, 10, 20 ... ms, capped at 200 ms and clamped to the deadline. Two new tests cover the schedule and the completion, exit-3 and slow cases. The existing deadline-kill test still passes.
- `docs/decisions.md` has a new D126 and `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased "Changed".

I made no test-side edits to the five binaries, `common/mod.rs` or `run.rs`. The memo was enough to show the cause and cut the time, and no measured cause remained there that I could fix without changing a test.

**Per-binary times (sum of "finished in" lines from one full `cargo test --locked` at base and one after, in seconds):**

| Binary | Tests | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| lifecycle | 66 | 170.86 | 88.18 |
| job_plan | 23 | 79.83 | 36.22 |
| drain | 79 | 54.80 | 33.22 |
| retry | 13 | 53.40 | 27.63 |
| steward | 10 | 47.71 | 26.57 |
| all binaries | | 649.4 | 389.3 |

The binary names are matched to the unnamed `-q` output by test count and order.

The test count rose by 7: 2 in `athena-core` and 5 in `athena-gate`. A last full run after the final edits passed and had the same per-binary times to within about a second.","files":["docs/decisions.md","CHANGELOG.md","crates/athena-gate/src/secrets.rs","crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs"],"checks_run":[{"command":"cargo test --locked -q (base, before any edit)","result":"pass","note":"All passed; sum of finished-in 649.4 s"},{"command":"cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle (single-test and full binary, several times)","result":"pass","note":"171.84 s base; 87–88 s after"},{"command":"cargo test --locked -p athena-gate secrets","result":"pass","note":"13 passed"},{"command":"cargo test --locked -p athena-core --lib checks","result":"pass","note":"22 passed; with a temporary failing test it exited 101, test removed after"},{"command":"cargo test --locked -q (after changes, and again after the final edits)","result":"pass","note":"All passed; sum of finished-in about 389 s"},{"command":"cargo fmt --all --check","result":"pass","note":"clean"},{"command":"cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings","result":"pass","note":"clean"}],"criteria_check":[{"criterion":"docs/decisions.md has a new decision with per-binary before and after times (lifecycle, job_plan, drain, retry, steward), measured the same way in the job and labeled measured, with the cause found for each and the total suite time.","status":"met","evidence":"D126 in docs/decisions.md has a table with before/after for lifecycle 170.86→88.18, job_plan 79.83→36.22, drain 54.80→33.22, retry 53.40→27.63, steward 47.71→26.57, from the 'finished in' lines of two full `cargo test --locked -q` runs. The decision gives a cause for each: the traced gitleaks launches for lifecycle, and for the other four the same default flow, stated as inferred and not traced one by one. The sums 649.4 s and 389.3 s are labeled measured. The 'About 456 s' figure adds the brain's compile time and is stated as above the goal. Weakness: the before and after figures are from single runs; the binary names were matched to the unnamed `-q` output by test count and order."},{"criterion":"The decision records compile 67 s vs run 673 s (brain-measured, 4 cores). It lists cargo-nextest 0.9.148 (584 s vs 673 s, about 13%) as rejected. It lists sccache (D79) and a shared target dir as considered. It claims no unmeasured number.","status":"met","evidence":"The D126 Case states compile 67 s vs run 673 s, brain-measured, 4 cores. The Alternatives section lists nextest 0.9.148 as rejected (584 s vs 673 s, about 13%), and lists sccache (D79) and a shared target dir as considered, not adopted. Brain figures are labeled reported/not re-measured in the Provenance line. The about 456 s figure is labeled as built from the brain's compile figure. I wrote the decision text myself, so this is a self-check."},{"criterion":"No test is deleted, ignored, filtered or has assertions weakened, and the test count is not lower than before. athena.toml, ci.yml and tool pins are unchanged. CHANGELOG.md has an entry.","status":"met","evidence":"`git status --short` shows only CHANGELOG.md, checks.rs, secrets.rs and decisions.md modified. The only test edits are additions in checks.rs (2 tests) and secrets.rs (5 tests). The full-suite counts are the same as at base except +2 in the 386-test binary and +5 in the 123-test binary; the ignored counts are unchanged (1, 3 and 1). The temporary failing test was removed. CHANGELOG.md has a new bullet under Unreleased 'Changed'."},{"criterion":"Production changes are limited to the scan memo in crates/athena-gate/src/secrets.rs and the shorter poll schedule in crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs. Each leaves behavior unchanged and has a test: the memo equals uncached scanning, and the poll schedule still detects completion, failure and timeout.","status":"met","evidence":"`git status --short` lists only those two Rust files. The scratch logging I added to crates/athena-git/src/lib.rs and secrets.rs was removed; lib.rs is not in the status list. Tests: `cargo test --locked -p athena-gate secrets` passed 13 tests (including the memo-equals-uncached, repeat-is-a-hit, moved-ref, later-token, unresolved-never-kept, text, and allow-list tests). `cargo test --locked -p athena-core --lib checks` passed with 22 tests: the schedule test (5,10,20,40,80,160,200,200,200, clamp to remaining), exit 0, exit 3 and a 0.5 s check still seen to finish, and the existing 300 ms deadline kill test."},{"criterion":"Run `cargo test --locked`. It passes with every test running, and the run is under 7 minutes on the job's machine. A failing test still fails the run.","status":"unmet","evidence":"`cargo test --locked -q` passes (exit 0, no filtered tests, ignored counts unchanged at base values), and a temporary failing test made `cargo test --locked -p athena-core --lib checks` exit 101 (removed afterwards). Under 7 minutes is not shown: the per-binary run times sum to about 389 s, and I did not time the full command including a cold compile. With the brain's 67 s compile the projection is about 456 s, above 420 s. The failing-test demonstration used the athena-core lib run, not the full suite."},{"criterion":"Run `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check`. Both are clean.","status":"met","evidence":"`cargo fmt --all --check` printed nothing (exit 0). `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` finished with no warnings. Both ran after the last code edits, apart from removing the temporary failing test, which did not touch formatting."}],"open_issues":["The 7-minute goal is probably not met: run-time sum is about 389 s, plus compile (brain-measured 67 s, not re-measured) is about 456 s against 420 s. I did not measure the total wall time of the command.","The plan expected test-side cuts if the projection stayed over budget. None were made: the remaining time is gitleaks range scans (351 in lifecycle, all distinct) that the memo cannot remove, and I found no change that cuts them without weakening a test. The next lever is outside the listed deliverables: history_pr_head, cutover_fixture and auditor take about 50 s together and may rebuild a heavy fixture per test.","Departure from the plan: the memo's per-key cell lock is held while gitleaks runs, so a second caller of the same input waits instead of starting its own scan. The table's global lock is never held across a run. Without this, parallel tests with the same text would each launch gitleaks.","Departure from the plan: scan_text is also memoized, because the trace showed repeats (the plan allowed this if step 1 counted repeats).","The temporary failing-test demonstration ran in `athena-core --lib checks`, not the full suite; a failing test also fails `cargo test --locked` as cargo stops at the first failing binary.","Memo hits and launch counts were traced for lifecycle only; the other four binaries' causes are inferred from the same default flow."],"mistakes":["Early on I tried an env-prefixed cargo command and a grep pipe; both were refused.","I did not capture a per-binary 'before' run with names; the baseline was one unnamed `-q` full run matched to binaries by test count and order. Test-by-test traces cover only lifecycle."],"learnings":["Gitleaks start-up costs about 0.5 s per launch even for an 11-byte text, and the tests are CPU-bound on gitleaks. A landed fake job launches it 14 times; git calls are 1–8 ms.","Lifecycle's range scans (351) are all distinct, so only text-scan repeats are saved by the memo. About 494 of 932 launches were avoided.","Athena::ask and go run in-process in the athena-cli tests, so a process-wide memo works across tests in one binary.","`athena_git::Git::rev_parse` resolves a rev to a commit id, which the memo uses.","Bash here refuses env prefixes, pipes and grep, so per-launch profiling needed a temporary source change.","history_pr_head (3 tests, about 18.3 s), cutover_fixture (4, about 14.6 s) and auditor (8, about 16–19 s) are also slow."],"desires":["A way to time a command from Bash, or per-test timing, would have avoided temporary instrumentation.","A way to run gitleaks directly to see where its 0.5 s start-up goes."]}
